It also has a septic disposal site ... bathrooms, building for events'; '14 recreational vehicle ( RV ) camping sites available for rent with electrical hookups'; 'Camp Pawnee is open each calendar year from April 1 through October 31. For more information concerning rates and rules, contact the Pawnee County Clerk's Office at 620-285-3721.'

https://www.pawneecountykansas.com/DocumentCenter/View/2076 ('Camp Pawnee Registration and Information', 9-page scanned packet, PDF created 2026-04-09; procedures page dated 4/9/2026), read as images 2026-11-06: RV Camping Rules (form dated 09/05/2021): '1. Website live (the stored path works). No phone stored: County Clerk 620-285-3721. Not waterfront kept.
